title: USG Programming Branch
text:
USG Programming Branch

Purpose: The Programming Department works formally with student organizations on campus to coordinate activities and pool resources. It promotes diversity, education, and entertainment through on-campus events. It has 16 community-focused assemblies and 4 special-interest committees. Assemblies act as umbrella organizations for member groups. They provide funding, advisement, and a forum for event planning and information sharing. The page does not mention a Program Board.

Assemblies (2025-26), with focus and listed contact:
- Academic Culture (ACA): interdisciplinary learning and academic student organizations. usgaca@usc.edu
- Asian Pacific American Student (APASA): APIDA heritage, culture, and unity. apasa@usc.edu
- Black Student (BSA): leadership development, service, and education on shared struggles and successes. usgbsa@usc.edu
- Environmental Student (ESA): sustainability and environmental advocacy. uscesa@usc.edu
- First Generation Student (FGSA): support for first-generation students. uscfgsu@gmail.com
- International Student (ISA): promoting international culture and diversity awareness. usgisa@usc.edu (page display shows isa@usc.edu; verify)
- Joint Assembly for Military-Associated Students (JAMS): community for military-associated students. usgjams@usc.edu
- Latine Student (LSA): heritage pride and support for Latine students. usglsa@usc.edu
- Native American Student (NASA): voice and support for Native American and American Indian students. uscnasa@usc.edu (display shows uscpsa@usc.edu; verify)
- Middle Eastern North African Student (MENASA): MENA culture, connection, and community giving. uscmenasa@gmail.com (display differs; verify)
- Political Student (PSA): political discourse, debate, and activism. uscpsa@usc.edu
- Queer and Ally Student (QUASA): social, educational, and cultural events for queer students. quasa@usc.edu
- Student Assembly for Accessibility (SAA): representation for students with disabilities. usc.accessibility@gmail.com
- Student Assembly for Gender Empowerment (SAGE): feminist and intersectional programming. uscsage@usc.edu (display shows wsa@usc.edu; verify)
- Transfer Student (TSA): transfer student advocacy and connection. tsausc@usc.edu
- Immigrant Trojan Student: safe space and advocacy for undocumented+ students and allies. usgutsa@usc.edu

Committees (2025-26):
- Concerts Committee: books concerts and speaker series. 'Anyone with an interest in live music is encouraged to come to our meetings on Mondays at 9:00 pm in TCC 450.' Contact: sconcert@usc.edu
- Performing Arts Committee (P.A.C.): creates opportunities in visual and performing arts, including dance, music, theater, and photography. Contact: usgpac@usc.edu
- Trojan Pride Committee: coordinates with the athletic department to increase attendance and visibility at USC athletic events. Contact: scpride@usc.edu
- Speakers Committee: brings speakers to campus each year. Past speakers listed include Barack Obama, Maya Angelou, Stan Lee, and Angela Davis. 'All are welcome to join!' Contact: speakers@usc.edu

Getting involved: The page lists no application process or deadlines. To get involved, contact the relevant assembly or committee, or follow its Instagram account (linked on the page). Committee and assembly member organizations can receive funding and advisement through their assembly.
